regulator.name: Sectoral — FTC, HHS OCR, CFPB, SEC and others

instruments.name: FTC Act Section 5 (unfair or deceptive acts or practices)
HIPAA Privacy, Security and Breach Notification Rules (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164)
Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act and the FTC Safeguards Rule (16 CFR Part 314)
Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule (16 CFR Part 312)

facet_hints.sectoral: There is no general federal privacy statute. Determine which sectoral regime applies before reporting anything: health data (HIPAA, and only for covered entities and business associates), financial (GLBA), children under 13 (COPPA), everything else (FTC Act s5 and state law).
facet_hints.deception: FTC Act s5 makes a privacy policy that does not match the code an enforceable deception. Compare stated practice to observed practice — this is the highest-value check in this pack.
facet_hints.safeguards: The FTC Safeguards Rule imposes specific technical requirements on non-bank financial institutions, including encryption, MFA and a written information security programme.
facet_hints.children: COPPA applies to under-13s and carries per-violation civil penalties.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search FTC consent orders and complaints for comparable practices.

seed_obligations.title: Do not misrepresent your data practices
applies_when: publishes a privacy policy or makes any public statement about data handling
testable_as: the privacy policy matches what the code actually does
claims about encryption, retention, sharing and training use are true

seed_obligations.title: Obtain verifiable parental consent before collecting personal information from children under 13
applies_when: the service is directed to children under 13 or has actual knowledge of under-13 users

seed_obligations.title: Maintain a written information security programme meeting the Safeguards Rule
applies_when: is a non-bank financial institution under GLBA
testable_as: encryption of customer information in transit and at rest
MFA on systems holding customer information

seed_obligations.title: Meet the HIPAA Security Rule safeguards for electronic protected health information
applies_when: is a covered entity or business associate handling ePHI
testable_as: business associate agreements with every vendor touching ePHI
